decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed contained a high volume of accessories such as carrying cases, adapters, and chargers, which were immediately filtered out. I focused on five distinct speaker options: the high-end JBL Flip 5 (standard), the budget-conscious Comiso 30W, the ultra-portable EWA A106, the rugged HyperGear Beast XL, and the mid-range Eduplink. I ultimately selected the JBL Flip 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_166) because it offers the highest rating (4.8) and the most reliable brand reputation for sound quality and durability among the available options. While more expensive than the generic brands, its massive review count and consistent performance make it the safest value-for-money purchase.
